newsitem.title: FRANCE: France signs agreement with Russia on tsarist debt.
newsitem.headline: France signs agreement with Russia on tsarist debt.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Tuesday that France and Russia had signed an agreement to resolve a dispute between the two countries over the payment to French holders of tsarist debt issued by Moscow before 1917.
The accord covered payments of $400 million over several years, he said, without specifying further.
France signs agreement with Russia on =2

The amount compares to the 140 to 160 billion francs claimed by the original French buyers, mostly in unpaid interest, and the agreement was immediately slammed by the association of Russian debt holders as a purely symbolic payment.
Juppe was speaking after talks with Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, in Paris for a two-day visit.
Chernomyrdin said before leaving Moscow that Russia would pay the debt run up by its pre-1917 tsarist government and repudiated by the Soviet Union after the communist revolution.
